description: Locating and calibrating AMD2's single borderline hydrophobic window against proteins of known topology, so the transmembrane call is reported honestly
code:
import requests, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ACC="P22580"
fa = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{ACC}.fasta", timeout=60).text
SEQ = "".join(l.strip() for l in fa.splitlines() if not l.startswith(">"))
KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
      'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
      'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
W=19
hyd = np.array([np.mean([KD[c] for c in SEQ[i:i+W]]) for i in range(len(SEQ)-W+1)])
i = int(hyd.argmax())
print(f"AMD2 global hydropathy maximum: {hyd.max():+.3f} at window {i+1}-{i+W}")
print("window sequence:", SEQ[i:i+W])
print("windows >= 1.60 :", int((hyd>=1.6).sum()), " | windows > 1.80 :", int((hyd>1.8).sum()))
print("A real TM helix in a 19-aa KD scan typically exceeds +1.8 and often +2.2.")

# Calibrate against proteins of known topology
def one(acc):
    t = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=60).text
    return "".join(l.strip() for l in t.splitlines() if not l.startswith(">"))
panel = {"AMD2 (P22580)":SEQ,
         "FAAH1 human, 1 TM (O00519)":one("O00519"),
         "FAAH2 human, membrane (Q6GMR7)":one("Q6GMR7"),
         "AmdS A.nidulans, cytosolic (P08158)":one("P08158"),
         "MDH3 yeast, peroxisomal matrix (P32419)":one("P32419"),
         "PMA1 yeast, polytopic membrane (P05030)":one("P05030")}
rows=[]
for nm,s in panel.items():
    h = np.array([np.mean([KD[c] for c in s[j:j+W]]) for j in range(len(s)-W+1)])
    rows.append(dict(protein=nm, length=len(s), max_KD=round(float(h.max()),2),
                     n_ge_1p6=int((h>=1.6).sum()), n_gt_1p8=int((h>1.8).sum()),
                     n_gt_2p2=int((h>2.2).sum())))
T = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n", T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("FINAL_hydropathy_calibration.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4))
ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(hyd)+1), hyd, color="#1565c0", lw=1)
ax.axhline(1.6, color="#ef6c00", ls="--", lw=1, label="1.60 screening threshold")
ax.axhline(1.8, color="#c62828", ls="--", lw=1, label="1.80 typical TM-helix floor")
ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.5)
ax.plot([i+1],[hyd.max()], "o", color="#c62828", ms=7)
ax.annotate(f"single window at {hyd.max():+.2f}\n{SEQ[i:i+W]}", xy=(i+1, hyd.max()),
            xytext=(i-150, 2.6), fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8))
ax.set_xlabel("window start position in AMD2 (19-residue Kyte-Doolittle window)")
ax.set_ylabel("mean hydropathy")
ax.set_title("AMD2 has no transmembrane-grade hydrophobic segment; its single peak just touches the screening threshold")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
